---
title: "03_covariates_ipw_sample_rebuilt_v5_citizenship_backfill"
output: html_document
---

## Overview

Constructs the parent and non-parenting samples for the multi-group analysis,
assigns the non-parenting pseudo-event window, attaches the propensity-score
covariates at **signal 0 / baseline**, and assembles the person-level IPW input.

**Requires:** rebuilt `01_datacleaning_primary.Rmd`

**Key design decisions**

- Parent multi-group sample starts from the structurally eligible parent grid
  **before** the parent-only 6/8 life-satisfaction rule.
- Signal 0 is the growth-model baseline and the covariate/IPW year.
- For non-parenting couples, signal 0 is randomly sampled from cohabitation
  year through cohabitation + 5 years.
- The non-parent pseudo-event is signal 3 = baseline + 3 years.
- Both groups require the same exact partner throughout signals 0-7.
- If both partners have observed positive PGEN household IDs in a signal year,
  those HIDs must match. Missing HIDs alone are not exclusionary.
- Both partners must have observed life satisfaction at signal 0 / baseline.
  Other missing propensity-score covariates are retained for later multiple
  imputation.
- Parents with baseline relationship duration >5 years are retained for now.
  Common support is evaluated later using propensity-score diagnostics rather
  than imposed here.
- Two isolated missing baseline German-citizenship values are recovered from
  each respondent's repeated, concordant nationality reports in subsequent
  SOEP waves before multiple imputation.

**Outputs** (to `data/derived/`):

- `parent.rds` — full 8-signal parent multi-group grid
- `parent_sample.rds` — parent signal-0/IPW rows
- `childless.rds` — full 8-signal non-parenting grid
- `childless_sample.rds` — non-parent signal-0/IPW rows
- `childless_anchor.rds` — reproducible random baseline/pseudo-event assignment
- `ipw_sample.rds` — combined person-level baseline covariate data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(here)

options(scipen = 999)

RANDOM_SEED <- 42L
BASELINE_OFFSETS <- 0:5

assert_unique <- function(data, keys, object_name) {
  dup <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    print(head(dup, 20))
    stop(object_name, " is not unique on: ", paste(keys, collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```

```{r load-inputs}
swb                   <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "swb.rds"))
partner_data          <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "partner_data.rds"))
partner_link_all      <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "partner_link_all.rds"))
relationship_episodes <- readRDS(here("data", "derived", "relationship_episodes.rds"))

parent_candidates <- readRDS(
  here("data", "derived", "parent_window_candidates.rds")
)

pgen     <- readRDS(here("data", "pgen.rds"))     %>% zap_labels()
biobirth <- readRDS(here("data", "biobirth.rds")) %>% zap_labels()
bioedu   <- readRDS(here("data", "bioedu.rds"))   %>% zap_labels()
ppathl   <- readRDS(here("data", "ppathl.rds"))   %>% zap_labels()
hgen     <- readRDS(here("data", "hgen.rds"))     %>% zap_labels()
hbrutto  <- readRDS(here("data", "hbrutto.rds"))  %>% zap_labels()

pgen     <- pgen     %>% mutate(pid = as.numeric(pid))
biobirth <- biobirth %>% mutate(pid = as.numeric(pid))
bioedu   <- bioedu   %>% mutate(pid = as.numeric(pid))
ppathl   <- ppathl   %>% mutate(pid = as.numeric(pid))

assert_unique(pgen, c("pid", "syear"), "pgen")
assert_unique(swb,  c("pid", "syear"), "swb")

# Annual household ID used as a positive-evidence co-residence check.
# Only positive HIDs are treated as observed. Missing/invalid HIDs do not by
# themselves count against a couple.
annual_hid <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    syear,
    hid_pgen = if_else(
      as.numeric(hid) > 0,
      as.numeric(hid),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

assert_unique(
  annual_hid,
  c("pid", "syear"),
  "annual_hid"
)

DATA_FIRST_YEAR <- min(swb$syear, na.rm = TRUE)
DATA_LAST_YEAR  <- max(swb$syear, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nSOEP outcome coverage:", DATA_FIRST_YEAR, "to", DATA_LAST_YEAR, "\n")
cat("Structural parent couples inherited from 01:",
    n_distinct(parent_candidates$couple_id), "\n")
```

```{r parent-multigroup-sample}
parent_rel_person <- parent_candidates %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id, pid, partner_id,
    window_start, window_end
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes,
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    cohabit_start <= window_start,
    cohabit_end >= window_end
  ) %>%
  arrange(couple_id, pid, desc(cohabit_start)) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

parent_rel <- parent_rel_person %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    couple_cohabit = max(cohabit_start),
    couple_cohabit_end = min(cohabit_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_members == 2)

stopifnot(
  nrow(parent_rel) == n_distinct(parent_candidates$couple_id)
)

parent <- parent_candidates %>%
  left_join(
    parent_rel %>%
      select(couple_id, couple_cohabit, couple_cohabit_end),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_year = window_start,
    event_year = reporting_year,
    group = 1L,
    rel_duration = baseline_year - couple_cohabit
  )

assert_unique(parent, c("couple_id", "pid", "signal"), "parent")

# Sanity check: cleaned 01 should already guarantee no signal year in which
# both partners have observed positive HIDs that disagree.
parent_hid_check <- parent %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, signal, syear) %>%
  left_join(
    annual_hid,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, signal, syear) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_hid_observed = sum(!is.na(hid_pgen)),
    n_distinct_hid = n_distinct(hid_pgen, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_hid_mismatch =
      n_members == 2 &
      n_hid_observed == 2 &
      n_distinct_hid > 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nParent signal-years with observed HID mismatch:",
    sum(parent_hid_check$observed_hid_mismatch), "\n")

stopifnot(!any(parent_hid_check$observed_hid_mismatch))

# Multi-group outcome eligibility:
# BOTH partners must have observed life satisfaction at signal 0 / baseline.
# Do NOT apply the parent-only 6/8 + mandatory-signal rule here.
parent_baseline_ok <- parent %>%
  filter(signal == 0) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    both_baseline_ls = sum(!is.na(life_sat)) == 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    both_baseline_ls
  ) %>%
  select(couple_id)

cat("\nParent couples before signal-0 LS requirement:",
    n_distinct(parent$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Parent couples with both partners observed at signal 0:",
    nrow(parent_baseline_ok), "\n")

# Keep the full 8-signal grid only for multi-group-eligible parent couples.
parent <- parent %>%
  semi_join(parent_baseline_ok, by = "couple_id")

# Signal 0 is the IPW / baseline year.
parent_sample <- parent %>%
  filter(signal == 0) %>%
  select(
    couple_id, pid, partner_id, sex,
    baseline_year, event_year,
    couple_cohabit, couple_cohabit_end,
    rel_duration,
    cid, hid, life_sat
  )

assert_unique(parent_sample, c("couple_id", "pid"), "parent_sample")
stopifnot(nrow(parent_sample) == 2 * n_distinct(parent_sample$couple_id))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(parent_sample$life_sat)))

cat("\n--- PARENT MULTI-GROUP SAMPLE ---\n")
cat("Couples:", n_distinct(parent_sample$couple_id), "\n")
cat("People:", n_distinct(parent_sample$pid), "\n")
cat("Baseline LS missing:", sum(is.na(parent_sample$life_sat)), "\n")

parent_support <- parent_sample %>%
  distinct(couple_id, rel_duration)

cat("\nParent relationship duration at signal 0:\n")
print(as.data.frame(
  parent_support %>%
    count(rel_duration) %>%
    arrange(rel_duration) %>%
    mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / sum(n),
      cumulative_pct = cumsum(pct)
    )
))

cat("\nParents with signal-0 relationship duration 0-5:",
    sum(between(parent_support$rel_duration, 0, 5)),
    "of", nrow(parent_support),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n",
            100 * mean(between(parent_support$rel_duration, 0, 5))))

cat("Parents with signal-0 relationship duration >5:",
    sum(parent_support$rel_duration > 5), "\n")

stopifnot(all(parent_support$rel_duration >= 0))
```

```{r nonparent-positive-childless}
childless_ids <- biobirth %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    sumkids = as.numeric(sumkids),
    first_birth_raw = as.numeric(kidgeb01)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sumkids == 0,
    !(first_birth_raw > 0)
  ) %>%
  distinct(pid)

cat("\nBIOBIRTH respondents positively recorded as childless:",
    nrow(childless_ids), "\n")

childless_links <- partner_data %>%
  semi_join(childless_ids, by = "pid") %>%
  semi_join(childless_ids, by = c("partner_id" = "pid"))

childless_verified <- childless_links %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes,
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    syear >= cohabit_start,
    syear <= cohabit_end
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    couple_id = paste0(
      pmin(pid, partner_id),
      "_",
      pmax(pid, partner_id)
    )
  )

assert_unique(
  childless_verified,
  c("pid", "syear"),
  "childless_verified"
)

childless_members_raw <- childless_verified %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, partner_id)

valid_childless_pairs <- childless_members_raw %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_partner_ids = n_distinct(partner_id),
    reciprocal = setequal(unique(pid), unique(partner_id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    n_partner_ids == 2,
    reciprocal
  ) %>%
  select(couple_id)

childless_members <- childless_members_raw %>%
  semi_join(valid_childless_pairs, by = "couple_id")

cat("Reciprocal exact-partner childless couples:",
    n_distinct(childless_members$couple_id), "\n")
```

```{r nonparent-sex-and-common-episodes}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SEX + HETEROSEXUAL DYAD REQUIREMENT
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

sex_data <- ppathl %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    sex = case_when(
      sex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.numeric(sex),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)

childless_members <- childless_members %>%
  left_join(
    sex_data,
    by = "pid"
  )

hetero_childless_ids <- childless_members %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_male = sum(sex == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(sex == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    n_male == 1,
    n_female == 1
  ) %>%
  select(couple_id)

childless_members <- childless_members %>%
  semi_join(
    hetero_childless_ids,
    by = "couple_id"
  )

cat(
  "Heterosexual reciprocal childless couples:",
  n_distinct(childless_members$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(childless_members$couple_id) > 0
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMMON EXACT RELATIONSHIP EPISODE REPORTED BY BOTH PARTNERS
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

episode_side_a <- childless_members %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    partner_id
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes %>%
      select(
        pid,
        partner_id,
        cohabit_start,
        cohabit_end
      ),
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(pid < partner_id) %>%
  transmute(
    couple_id,
    pid_low = pid,
    pid_high = partner_id,
    start_a = cohabit_start,
    end_a = cohabit_end
  )

episode_side_b <- childless_members %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    partner_id
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    relationship_episodes %>%
      select(
        pid,
        partner_id,
        cohabit_start,
        cohabit_end
      ),
    by = c("pid", "partner_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(pid > partner_id) %>%
  transmute(
    couple_id,
    pid_low = partner_id,
    pid_high = pid,
    start_b = cohabit_start,
    end_b = cohabit_end
  )

# Intersection of the two partners' recorded episodes.
childless_common_raw <- episode_side_a %>%
  inner_join(
    episode_side_b,
    by = c(
      "couple_id",
      "pid_low",
      "pid_high"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    common_start = pmax(start_a, start_b),
    common_end = pmin(end_a, end_b)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(common_start),
    !is.na(common_end),
    common_end >= common_start
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid_low,
    pid_high,
    common_start,
    common_end
  )

cat("\n--- RECIPROCAL RELATIONSHIP EPISODE CHECK ---\n")
cat("Low-PID episode rows:", nrow(episode_side_a), "\n")
cat("High-PID episode rows:", nrow(episode_side_b), "\n")
cat("Overlapping reciprocal episode rows:", nrow(childless_common_raw), "\n")
cat(
  "Couples with >=1 reciprocal overlapping episode:",
  n_distinct(childless_common_raw$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(childless_common_raw$couple_id) > 0
)

# Collapse overlapping/adjacent common intervals for the same exact couple.
childless_common_intervals <- childless_common_raw %>%
  arrange(
    couple_id,
    common_start,
    common_end
  ) %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  mutate(
    previous_max_end = lag(cummax(common_end)),
    new_episode = if_else(
      row_number() == 1L |
        common_start > previous_max_end + 1,
      1L,
      0L
    ),
    common_episode_id = cumsum(new_episode)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    common_episode_id
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    couple_cohabit = min(common_start),
    couple_cohabit_end = max(common_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\nHeterosexual childless couples with common exact-partner episode:",
  n_distinct(childless_common_intervals$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(childless_common_intervals$couple_id) > 0
)

# Eight annual positions (signals 0-7) span seven calendar-year differences.
childless_interval_check <- childless_common_intervals %>%
  mutate(
    relationship_span = couple_cohabit_end - couple_cohabit
  )

cat("\n--- CHILDLESS RELATIONSHIP SPAN ---\n")
print(
  childless_interval_check %>%
    summarise(
      episodes = n(),
      span_at_least_7 = sum(relationship_span >= 7),
      pct_span_at_least_7 = 100 * mean(relationship_span >= 7),
      span_at_least_8 = sum(relationship_span >= 8),
      median_span = median(relationship_span),
      max_span = max(relationship_span)
    )
)
```

```{r nonparent-baseline-candidates}
childless_baseline_candidates <- tidyr::crossing(
  childless_common_intervals,
  baseline_offset = BASELINE_OFFSETS
) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_year = couple_cohabit + baseline_offset,
    event_year = baseline_year + 3L,
    window_start = baseline_year,
    window_end = baseline_year + 7L
  ) %>%
  filter(
    window_end <= couple_cohabit_end,
    window_start >= DATA_FIRST_YEAR,
    window_end <= DATA_LAST_YEAR
  )

cat("\nChildless couples with >=1 structurally valid 0-5 baseline:",
    n_distinct(childless_baseline_candidates$couple_id), "\n")

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(childless_baseline_candidates$couple_id) > 0
)

candidate_window_rows <- childless_baseline_candidates %>%
  inner_join(
    childless_members %>%
      select(couple_id, pid, partner_id, sex),
    by = "couple_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::uncount(weights = 8, .id = "signal") %>%
  mutate(
    signal = signal - 1L,
    syear = baseline_year + signal
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    partner_link_all,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    annual_hid,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  )

# Evaluate partner constancy and co-residence separately within each signal year.
# Different HIDs across different years are fine; the exclusion is triggered
# only if both partners have observed HIDs in the SAME year and those HIDs differ.
candidate_year_check <- candidate_window_rows %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    common_episode_id,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    baseline_offset,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    signal,
    syear
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),

    any_conflicting_partner = any(
      !is.na(partner_id_obs) &
        partner_id_obs != partner_id
    ),

    n_hid_observed = sum(!is.na(hid_pgen)),
    n_distinct_hid = n_distinct(hid_pgen, na.rm = TRUE),

    observed_hid_mismatch =
      n_members == 2 &
      n_hid_observed == 2 &
      n_distinct_hid > 1,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nCandidate control signal-years with observed HID mismatch:",
    sum(candidate_year_check$observed_hid_mismatch), "\n")

valid_childless_baselines <- candidate_year_check %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    common_episode_id,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    baseline_offset,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    all_years_two_members = all(n_members == 2),
    any_conflicting_partner = any(any_conflicting_partner),
    any_hid_mismatch = any(observed_hid_mismatch),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    all_years_two_members,
    !any_conflicting_partner,
    !any_hid_mismatch
  ) %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    baseline_offset,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end
  )

cat(
  "Childless couples with >=1 baseline passing full-window partner + HID check:",
  n_distinct(valid_childless_baselines$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(valid_childless_baselines$couple_id) > 0
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REQUIRE BOTH PARTNERS TO HAVE SIGNAL-0 / BASELINE LIFE SATISFACTION
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check LS availability for EACH structurally valid candidate baseline before
# sampling the final baseline. This avoids choosing a missing baseline first
# and then excluding the couple afterward.

control_baseline_ls_check <- valid_childless_baselines %>%
  inner_join(
    childless_members %>%
      select(couple_id, pid),
    by = "couple_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    swb %>%
      select(pid, syear, life_sat),
    by = c("pid", "baseline_year" = "syear")
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    baseline_offset,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    both_baseline_ls = sum(!is.na(life_sat)) == 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

valid_childless_baselines_ls <- control_baseline_ls_check %>%
  filter(
    n_members == 2,
    both_baseline_ls
  ) %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    baseline_offset,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end
  )

cat(
  "Childless couples with >=1 valid baseline where both partners have LS:",
  n_distinct(valid_childless_baselines_ls$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  n_distinct(valid_childless_baselines_ls$couple_id) > 0
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ENSURE EACH PERSON CONTRIBUTES TO ONLY ONE CHILDLESS DYAD
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A small number of respondents can have multiple qualifying relationships
# at different periods of the panel. Randomly retain one eligible relationship
# for each multiply represented person.

eligible_childless_members <- childless_members %>%
  semi_join(
    valid_childless_baselines_ls %>%
      distinct(couple_id),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid
  )

duplicate_childless_pids <- eligible_childless_members %>%
  count(pid) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat(
  "\nPeople belonging to >1 eligible childless couple:",
  nrow(duplicate_childless_pids),
  "\n"
)

if (nrow(duplicate_childless_pids) > 0) {

  conflict_memberships <- eligible_childless_members %>%
    semi_join(
      duplicate_childless_pids,
      by = "pid"
    )

  print(
    as.data.frame(
      conflict_memberships %>%
        arrange(pid, couple_id)
    )
  )

  # In the current data, each contested couple contains only one person who
  # appears in multiple qualifying dyads. Fail loudly if that changes.
  conflict_structure <- conflict_memberships %>%
    count(couple_id)

  stopifnot(
    all(conflict_structure$n == 1)
  )

  # Separate seed from the pseudo-baseline draw below.
  set.seed(RANDOM_SEED + 1L)

  chosen_conflict_couples <- conflict_memberships %>%
    group_by(pid) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(couple_id)

  all_conflict_couples <- conflict_memberships %>%
    distinct(couple_id)

  # Keep all uncontested couples plus one randomly selected relationship for
  # each multiply represented person.
  valid_childless_baselines_unique <- bind_rows(
    valid_childless_baselines_ls %>%
      anti_join(
        all_conflict_couples,
        by = "couple_id"
      ),

    valid_childless_baselines_ls %>%
      semi_join(
        chosen_conflict_couples,
        by = "couple_id"
      )
  )

} else {

  valid_childless_baselines_unique <- valid_childless_baselines_ls
}

# Confirm that every person now appears in only one retained eligible dyad.
unique_childless_members <- childless_members %>%
  semi_join(
    valid_childless_baselines_unique %>%
      distinct(couple_id),
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(unique_childless_members$pid)
)

cat(
  "Eligible childless couples after person-level de-duplication:",
  n_distinct(valid_childless_baselines_unique$couple_id),
  "\n"
)

set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

childless_anchor <- valid_childless_baselines_unique %>%
  group_by(couple_id) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    group = 0L,
    rel_duration = baseline_year - couple_cohabit
  )

assert_unique(childless_anchor, "couple_id", "childless_anchor")

cat("\nSelected childless signal-0 baseline offsets:\n")
print(as.data.frame(
  childless_anchor %>%
    count(baseline_offset) %>%
    mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    arrange(baseline_offset)
))
```

```{r nonparent-window}
childless <- childless_anchor %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    baseline_year,
    event_year,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    couple_cohabit,
    couple_cohabit_end,
    rel_duration,
    group
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    childless_members %>%
      select(couple_id, pid, partner_id, sex),
    by = "couple_id",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::uncount(weights = 8, .id = "signal") %>%
  mutate(
    signal = signal - 1L,
    syear = baseline_year + signal
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    swb %>%
      select(pid, syear, cid, hid, life_sat),
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  )

assert_unique(
  childless,
  c("couple_id", "pid", "signal"),
  "childless"
)

# Final control-window sanity check for the selected pseudo-event windows.
childless_hid_check <- childless %>%
  distinct(couple_id, pid, signal, syear) %>%
  left_join(
    annual_hid,
    by = c("pid", "syear")
  ) %>%
  group_by(couple_id, signal, syear) %>%
  summarise(
    n_members = n_distinct(pid),
    n_hid_observed = sum(!is.na(hid_pgen)),
    n_distinct_hid = n_distinct(hid_pgen, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_hid_mismatch =
      n_members == 2 &
      n_hid_observed == 2 &
      n_distinct_hid > 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(!any(childless_hid_check$observed_hid_mismatch))

childless_sample <- childless %>%
  filter(signal == 0) %>%
  select(
    couple_id, pid, partner_id, sex,
    baseline_year, event_year,
    couple_cohabit, couple_cohabit_end,
    rel_duration,
    cid, hid, life_sat
  )

assert_unique(
  childless_sample,
  c("couple_id", "pid"),
  "childless_sample"
)

stopifnot(!any(is.na(childless_sample$life_sat)))

cat("\n--- NON-PARENTING MULTI-GROUP SAMPLE ---\n")
cat("Couples:", n_distinct(childless_sample$couple_id), "\n")
cat("People:", n_distinct(childless_sample$pid), "\n")
cat("Baseline LS missing:", sum(is.na(childless_sample$life_sat)), "\n")

childless_outcome_coverage <- childless %>%
  group_by(couple_id, pid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ls = sum(!is.na(life_sat)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("People with zero observed LS values across signals 0-7:",
    sum(childless_outcome_coverage$n_ls == 0), "\n")
cat("Couples with >=1 partner having zero LS values:",
    childless_outcome_coverage %>%
      group_by(couple_id) %>%
      summarise(any_zero = any(n_ls == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
      summarise(n = sum(any_zero)) %>%
      pull(n),
    "\n")
```

```{r baseline-identifiers}
baseline_ids <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    syear,
    cid_pgen = as.numeric(cid),
    hid_pgen = as.numeric(hid)
  )

fill_baseline_ids <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      cid = as.numeric(cid),
      hid = as.numeric(hid)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      baseline_ids,
      by = c("pid", "baseline_year" = "syear")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cid = coalesce(cid, cid_pgen),
      hid = coalesce(hid, hid_pgen)
    ) %>%
    select(-cid_pgen, -hid_pgen)
}

parent_sample <- fill_baseline_ids(parent_sample)
childless_sample <- fill_baseline_ids(childless_sample)
```

```{r combine-baseline}
parent_baseline_df <- parent_sample %>%
  mutate(group = 1L) %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    couple_id,
    syear = baseline_year,
    cid,
    hid,
    sex,
    life_sat,
    couple_cohabit,
    rel_duration,
    group
  )

childless_baseline_df <- childless_sample %>%
  mutate(group = 0L) %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    couple_id,
    syear = baseline_year,
    cid,
    hid,
    sex,
    life_sat,
    couple_cohabit,
    rel_duration,
    group
  )

ipw_sample <- bind_rows(
  parent_baseline_df,
  childless_baseline_df
)

assert_unique(ipw_sample, "pid", "ipw_sample")

cat("\n--- COMBINED IPW BASELINE SAMPLE ---\n")
cat("Total couples:", n_distinct(ipw_sample$couple_id), "\n")
cat("Parent couples:",
    n_distinct(ipw_sample$couple_id[ipw_sample$group == 1]), "\n")
cat("Non-parenting couples:",
    n_distinct(ipw_sample$couple_id[ipw_sample$group == 0]), "\n")
cat("Duplicate PIDs:", sum(duplicated(ipw_sample$pid)), "\n")

cat("\nRelationship-duration support at signal 0:\n")
print(as.data.frame(
  ipw_sample %>%
    distinct(couple_id, group, rel_duration) %>%
    count(group, rel_duration) %>%
    arrange(group, rel_duration)
))

cat("\nNOTE: parents above rel_duration 5 are retained here.\n")
cat("Propensity-score/common-support diagnostics should determine whether\n")
cat("a later support restriction or sensitivity analysis is necessary.\n")
```

```{r covariates}
age_bioedu <- bioedu %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    birth_yr = if_else(
      gebjahr > 0,
      as.numeric(gebjahr),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(birth_yr)) %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)

age_ppathl <- ppathl %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    birth_yr_p = if_else(
      gebjahr > 0,
      as.numeric(gebjahr),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(birth_yr_p)) %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(age_bioedu, by = "pid") %>%
  left_join(age_ppathl, by = "pid") %>%
  mutate(
    birth_yr = coalesce(birth_yr, birth_yr_p),
    age = syear - birth_yr
  ) %>%
  select(-birth_yr, -birth_yr_p)

citizen <- ppathl %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    germborn_raw = as.numeric(germborn),
    migration_raw = as.numeric(migback)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    germborn = case_when(
      germborn_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      germborn_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    migration = case_when(
      migration_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      migration_raw %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(pid, germborn, migration) %>%
  distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(citizen, by = "pid")

nation <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    syear,
    germcitz_raw = as.numeric(pgnation)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    germcitz = case_when(
      germcitz_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      germcitz_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(pid, syear, germcitz)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(nation, by = c("pid", "syear"))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LONGITUDINAL BACKFILL FOR TWO ISOLATED BASELINE CITIZENSHIP VALUES
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These are not model-based imputations. At the baseline/IPW year, pgnation
# is a nonresponse code for exactly two people. Their subsequent repeated
# nationality reports are concordant:
#   PID 5138502: 1994-1995 missing; 1996-1997 pgnation = 79 -> non-German (0)
#   PID 5601802: 1995 missing;      1996-1998 pgnation = 1  -> German (1)
# We therefore recover the baseline binary citizenship value from the
# respondent's own longitudinal record before multiple imputation.

citizenship_backfill <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pid,     ~syear, ~germcitz_fill,
  5138502,   1994,       0,
  5601802,   1995,       1
)

# Guard against accidentally overwriting an observed baseline value.
backfill_precheck <- ipw_sample %>%
  semi_join(citizenship_backfill, by = c("pid", "syear")) %>%
  select(pid, syear, germcitz)

stopifnot(
  nrow(backfill_precheck) == 2,
  all(is.na(backfill_precheck$germcitz))
)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(citizenship_backfill, by = c("pid", "syear")) %>%
  mutate(
    germcitz = coalesce(germcitz, germcitz_fill)
  ) %>%
  select(-germcitz_fill)

cat("\nCitizenship longitudinal backfill check:\n")
print(
  ipw_sample %>%
    filter(pid %in% c(5138502, 5601802)) %>%
    select(couple_id, group, sex, pid, syear, germborn, migration, germcitz)
)
cat("Remaining missing germcitz values:", sum(is.na(ipw_sample$germcitz)), "\n")
stopifnot(sum(is.na(ipw_sample$germcitz)) == 0)

employment <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    syear,
    employment_raw = as.numeric(pgemplst)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    employment = case_when(
      employment_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      employment_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      employment_raw == 2 ~ 2,
      employment_raw == 5 ~ 3,
      employment_raw %in% c(3, 4, 6, 7) ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(pid, syear, employment)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(employment, by = c("pid", "syear"))

education <- pgen %>%
  transmute(
    pid,
    syear,
    edu_raw = as.numeric(pgcasmin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    edu_level = case_when(
      edu_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      edu_raw %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3) ~ 1,
      edu_raw %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2,
      edu_raw %in% c(6, 7) ~ 3,
      edu_raw %in% c(8, 9) ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(pid, syear, edu_level)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  left_join(education, by = c("pid", "syear"))

cat("\nRaw hgnuts1_ew values:\n")
print(table(hgen$hgnuts1_ew, useNA = "ifany"))

household <- hgen %>%
  transmute(
    cid = as.numeric(cid),
    hid = as.numeric(hid),
    syear,
    hinc_raw = as.numeric(hghinc),
    hgowner_raw = as.numeric(hgowner),
    size_raw = as.numeric(hgsize),
    hgseval_raw = as.numeric(hgseval),
    move_year_raw = as.numeric(hgmoveyr),
    east_raw = as.numeric(hgnuts1_ew)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hinc = if_else(hinc_raw >= 0, hinc_raw, NA_real_),
    size = if_else(size_raw >= 0, size_raw, NA_real_),
    hgowner = case_when(
      hgowner_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      hgowner_raw == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    smallspace = case_when(
      hgseval_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      hgseval_raw %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    livedhere = case_when(
      move_year_raw > 0 & move_year_raw <= syear ~ syear - move_year_raw,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    east = case_when(
      east_raw < 0 ~ NA_real_,
      east_raw == 22 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    cid, hid, syear,
    hinc, hgowner, size,
    smallspace, livedhere, east
  )

assert_unique(
  household,
  c("cid", "hid", "syear"),
  "household"
)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
  mutate(
    cid = as.numeric(cid),
    hid = as.numeric(hid)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    household,
    by = c("cid", "hid", "syear")
  )

assert_unique(

)

ipw_sample <- ipw_sample %>%
```
